Name: Poking Stick
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a small simple mod. If you want to make an NPC go faster... poke them with a stick[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]
[/b][/size]A STICK!

Buy the stick from robin. Poke people. Pretty simple. Speed is configurable (may require a game restart to take effect)

Source Code is available on my [url=https://github.com/Huskyn1nja/StardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]
Comapatible with slow NPCs becoming fast NPCs


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI. Choose either a new or existing game and enjoy.
